written.headline: Congress moves to tighten export rules on AI chips after Nvidia spy scandal
written.summary: Following revelations regarding former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang's relationship with a suspected Chinese spy, US lawmakers are pushing for stricter export controls on advanced AI chips. Both Democrats and Republicans are reviewing legislative measures and demanding public testimony from industry and government leaders.

written.headline: Jensen Huang discusses Nvidia CEO comeback as allies lobby for return
written.summary: Former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang has reportedly discussed returning to lead the chipmaker with confidants, as allies form a lobbying effort for his reinstatement. Huang resigned following an investigation into personal relationships that involved an executive at Megaspeed.

written.headline: Megaspeed says Alice Huang left in 2025 amid US probe into Nvidia chip sales
written.summary: Singapore-based Megaspeed announced that former executive Alice Huang departed in August 2025 and holds no current role, defending its operations as lawful. The company purchased billions of dollars in Nvidia chips between 2024 and 2026, prompting a U.S. Commerce Department inquiry into potential export control violations.

written.headline: Nvidia sought Taipei's help after employee's chip smuggling case
written.summary: Nvidia appealed to Taiwanese officials and sought advice from TSMC after an Nvidia manager was charged over helping smuggle AI chips into China. Prosecutors accused the manager of being the core figure in a network that smuggled 74 servers containing Nvidia chips to China.
